body: I stand in the middle of the allotment path, the ribboned box lying beside me. The box seems untouched, but the ribbons are a stark reminder of its recent presence. A sense of indignation surges through me, and I feel a strong urge to confront whoever dropped the box. My mind starts to whirl with thoughts of who might have done this, what could be inside the box, and why it was left here.
